summary: xAI released Grok 4.6, an incremental update to Grok 4.5 with improved long-running agent, coding, and visual/interactive task performance, available via API, Cursor, Grok Build and other partners at stated pricing.

mechanisms.reason: The model underwent a longer supplemental training run than its predecessor, indicating incremental additional training compute use.
mechanisms.quote: Grok 4.6 underwent a longer supplemental training run than Grok 4.5, with curated model-generated data for reasoning and advanced technical concepts, high-quality engineering data, and an improved optimizer and training recipe.

practices.reason: The model shows improved sustained multi-step agentic performance and stronger first-pass visual/interactive application generation, relevant to teams building agent and coding tools but backed mostly by the lab's own comparative benchmarking.
practices.quote: Grok 4.6 builds on Grok 4.5 with a particular focus on long-running agents and more ambitious interactive and visual work.

practices.reason: The release reports scores on a mix of third-party and lab benchmarks (AA Intelligence Index, DeepSWE, CursorBench, FrontierCode, etc.) that a team could adopt to compare agentic coding models, though safety evals remain internal.
practices.quote: Grok 4.6 achieves frontier intelligence across several agentic coding and knowledge work benchmarks.

practices.reason: Teams using the API or partner platforms need to update model selection and pricing configuration for the new version and its faster, pricier variant.
practices.quote: Pricing starts at $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens. Additionally, there is a fast variant which is twice the price.
